basis: Body FRD relative to existing simulated CG; viewer maps (x,y,z) to (y,-z,-x)

provenance.measured: Existing user geometry: 0.90 m lateral centres, 0.78 m front-to-tail, 0.11 m coaxial spacing
provenance.estimated: 2026-11-11 photos establish approximate body/electronics. User-supplied Word hardware document confirms 25 mm tubes and 68.7 x 25.8 mm M6208 reference dimensions.
provenance.landingGear: 2026-11-12 user sets landing-gear height to 190 mm. Existing height convention is the vertical distance from simulated CG to all three ground contacts; attachment points and lateral/longitudinal footprint are retained.
provenance.propellers: User MSC 21x6.3 PDF: 533.4 mm diameter, 160.02 mm pitch, 47 g per complete two-blade propeller. Front propulsion now uses actual RPM to source thrust/torque; PWM-to-RPM remains estimated. Tail retains 6045 three-blade geometry.
provenance.battery: 2026-11-11 user: mount the battery under the body with its front face aligned to the front cross-tube centreline. Product dimensions are 177 x 65 x 56 mm, long axis fore-aft; 4 mm clearance below the bottom plate is a visual mounting assumption.

frontPropulsionModel: MSC21 RPM-to-thrust/torque, new-diameter coaxial estimate, gain 1, default 5000 RPM cap. Existing 23 V PWM-to-RPM speed target is an uncalibrated reference; below 3320 RPM F/Q use quadratic extrapolation.

battery.alignment: front face at frontBodyX; centred laterally; below lower fuselage plate
